propositions: A deterministic baseline eval harness in tests/external/ must capture raw LLM replies across provider-model cells under current and sentinel directive variants to measure before/after output distribution shifts

The harness must enforce a predeclared per-run call budget (default 300 calls) before any network calls, skip unmeasured cells when provider credentials are absent, and score parse success and layout-class rates against committed golden fixtures

A workflow_dispatch-only job in .github/workflows/structured-output-baseline.yml must scope per-provider API keys and upload raw replies and score tables as CI artifacts without gating the job on live-model nondeterminism
Unit tests must validate scorer golden counts on committed E2 fixtures, credential-absent skip paths, and call-budget enforcement logic in isolation before operator-triggered live dispatch runs
